git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'MSG' && git log --oneline -1
Insert only where the dictation was aimed

Whisper answers seconds after the key comes up, and in those seconds the cursor
may have moved — another field, another tab, another app. The text was typed
there anyway, and keystrokes another app accepted have no undo.

stopRecording() now pins the destination at release (focusTargetId(): bundle ID,
pid, focused-window id and title, plus the focused element's role/subrole/
identifier/title when the app exposes one — Electron apps expose none), and
finishInsertion() re-checks it right before inserting. On a mismatch nothing is
typed: output is forced to clipboard-only, two chimes play instead of one, and
the overlay marks the text CLIPBOARD:.

The target is per job like the rest of the pipeline, so a dictation that
finishes behind a newer recording is judged against the place it was spoken
into; queued dictations aimed at different places collapse to the clipboard
route. A nil target (AX unavailable) skips the check rather than refusing to
type. Measured 1.8 ms average per call.
